'''Zogres''' are encountered during the [[Zogre Flesh Eaters]] quest, and can be found in [[Jiggig]] and [[Jiggig Dungeon]] south-east of [[Castle Wars]]. When burying their bones in Jiggig, a [[skogre]] may appear and attack. Their name is a portmanteau of 'zombie ogre'. According to [[Juna]], zogres fought for [[Zamorak]] during the [[God Wars]] and 'could repel the forces of [[Saradomin]] with their stench alone.'

==Strengths and weaknesses==
Zogres are almost immune to normal weapons (you will hit just as often, but damage is reduced by 75%).{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1747570723487461880|date=17 January 2024|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/27964618|archivedate=04 November 2026|quote=Damage divided by 4. I didn't see any sign of a floor.}} [[Brutal arrows]] are effective against them, as is the [[Crumble Undead]] spell (however, damage is halved, for a maximum of 7). The [[salve amulet]] and its variants are effective against Zogres as they are undead.

Zogres are also capable of infecting the player with [[disease]]. Disease can be cured with [[Sanfew serum]] or [[Relicym's balm]], the latter of which may be bought from [[Uglug Nar]] outside Jiggig for {{Coins|200}}. An [[inoculation bracelet]] will prevent damage taken from disease, but will not grant immunity to becoming diseased. 

If its bones are buried within Jiggig or Jiggig Dungeon after killing them, there is a 1/3 chance to spawn a [[Skogre]], which will initially be aggressive to the player who spawned it regardless of combat level.

==Trivia==
*The zogres playing the drums can be attacked but only with [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]]. Players will also need to telegrab their items, should they wish to pick them up.
*The colour of the drums that the zogres play is slightly lighter than that of the other drums.
